name: windmill_blade
description: Windmill rotor (风车叶片) generator: classic Dutch-mill 4-blade rotor in a vertical plane perpendicular to `facing` — centre hub (十字毂, ellipse.py disc) + 2-cell axle into the tower + 4 spars at 90° intervals. Rotation angle is SCRIPT-DERIVED from `variant` (x = X 形 45° 起始, plus = + 形; 禁止手改). Each spar is a 4-connected rasterized line (Manhattan 补格, 斜叶无对角悬空); sail=true adds a one-cell-wide canvas panel of bottom slabs (蒙布半砖面, 同向 type=bottom 无拼缝) on the trailing edge from 1/3 length outward.
when_to_use: 荷兰风车/磨坊地标转子; windmill/lighthouse 地标卡、farm_estate 磨坊。origin = 轮毂中心格(塔身上段外墙皮), y = 轮毂层; facing = 轴法线 = 转子面朝方向。叶尖活动半径 = length, 叶片扫掠圆直径 2L+1, 下方和侧面留净空。

origin.notes: 轮毂中心格(塔身外壁处); y = 轮毂层

facing.notes: 轴法线 = 转子面朝方向; 轴向后伸进塔身 2 格

length.notes: 叶尖半径(格); 扫掠直径=2L+1

variant.notes: x=X 形(45° 起始, 经典荷兰风车); plus=+ 形(正十字)

sail.notes: true=后缘蒙布半砖面; false=裸骨架(装饰小风车)

sail_material.notes: 蒙布; 必须是 *_slab, 脚本自动加 type=bottom

pitfalls: 叶尖扫掠圆内必须净空 —— 叶片是装饰静物不会转, 但视觉上下方 2L+1 直径内有墙/树=穿模; 装前量塔高
origin 贴在塔身外壁, 轴向塔内伸 2 格 —— 塔身太小(<3 格厚)轴会从背墙穿出
sail_material 必须是 *_slab —— 蒙布用整方块会像木板墙失去帆布感; 羊毛无 slab, 别填 white_wool
length<6 时蒙布区只剩 2-3 格, X 形斜叶的蒙布呈阶梯状是栅格化正常形态, 不是 bug
转子朝北/南放时叶片在 X 面内, 朝东/西在 Z 面内 —— 朝向由 facing 脚本推导, 输出 JSON 禁止手改
example: python patterns/windmill_blade.py --params '{"origin":[100,80,100],"facing":"south","length":8,"variant":"x"}' --out rotor1.json && python patterns/windmill_blade.py --params '{"origin":[140,76,100],"facing":"west","length":6,"variant":"plus","sail":false}' --out rotor2.json
